title: The Unified Front End — a merged hybrid timeline

structure.merge: [2D Card Layer] + [3D Scene Layer] -> Merged Hybrid Timeline (index.html / manifest.json)
structure.discipline: the storyboard converter's manifest discipline: beats per layer, one merged timeline

storyboard_manifest.note: the film's beats ride inside beat F03 by reference; they are not re-issued here

sources.front_end_v2: the universal front end v2 — narration, law line, closing line verbatim
sources.adopted_spine: the numbered section spine (II Dawn / I Before / III Trinity / IV Peg & Proof / V Bind / V·B Diamond Law / VI Merit Economy / VII Live Broadcast / VIII Take Your Seat / VIII·B Fuel the Peg / IX Manifesto) of the hosted world build's landing, adopted as this package's architecture and menu — see STRUCTURE-MAP.md
sources.gate_contract: the hybrid-door back end — kick / challenge / respond / cancel / ceremony / session-verify
sources.telemetry: the telemetry wire spec — pull-first, /live/api/* shapes, authority none

beats.title: THE DAWN
beats.subject: The Law + The Visitor
beats.eye: The hero on the adopted spine: three rings, the one law verbatim, the heartbeat ticker, and the visitor's own date, time, zone, and number in their own settings.
beats.markers: spine slot II of the adopted architecture (see STRUCTURE-MAP.md); the law line stands verbatim, exactly once on the face; localization law: values render in the visitor's OS locale and timezone

beats.title: BEFORE — THE STORY
beats.subject: The Story of Everything
beats.eye: One narration section, spoken by the machine itself in the first person.
beats.markers: spine slot I; narration verbatim from the universal front end v2; the film's own 15 beats (14 active, H01 held) ride by reference to the storyboard manifest — format hybrid-intro-package-v1 — and are not re-issued here

beats.title: THE TRINITY
beats.subject: The Three Rings
beats.eye: Three cards, one per ring: Iris contains, the DCLM decides, Twain² witnesses.
beats.markers: spine slot III; the three-card skeleton is the adopted architecture's; each card carries its ring's own function in the machine's voice

beats.title: THE PEG & THE PROOF
beats.subject: eFuse + Merit
beats.eye: Two panels: the non-tradable peg, read-only; the proof token that is not one — zero issuance.
beats.markers: spine slot IV; both panels carry their DESIGN grade on their face; the peg's reference value renders in the visitor's own number format

beats.title: THE BIND
beats.subject: The Unity ID
beats.eye: Prose and the three steps — the peg prices, Unity owns, Merit pays — plus the physical bind chain.
beats.markers: spine slot V; the physical chain (reader -> POST /live/api/bind -> decision -> white ledger) is DESIGN, drawn in full in BINDING-PLAN.md

beats.title: THE DIAMOND LAW
beats.subject: The Word
beats.eye: The tile sequence: the seed, the first fork, the two word-widths, the word itself, floor and ceiling, refraction.
beats.markers: spine slot V·B; the 64-bit word discipline stated on the face: payload 63-32, finger 31-16, grade 15-8, authority 7-0; UNKNOWN never executes

beats.title: THE MERIT ECONOMY
beats.subject: The Fruits of Labor
beats.eye: Need, Labor, Fruit, Merit, the SAFE HOST, and Wants in their place — the compact, in rows.
beats.markers: spine slot VI; the doctrine stands as rows, each one line, under the one law

beats.title: LIVE BROADCAST
beats.subject: Telemetry
beats.eye: The published ledger reading, shown exactly as served; the families named with their honest state.
beats.markers: spine slot VII; pull-first; read-only; authority none; absence renders as NO SIGNAL, never as zero

beats.title: TAKE YOUR SEAT — THE GATE
beats.subject: The Unity ID
beats.eye: One control. The device answers a one-time challenge with a hash; the hash signs the session.
beats.markers: spine slot VIII; contract: the hybrid-door back end (kick / challenge / respond / cancel / ceremony / session-verify); failures render, only success moves; redirect budget two; loopback demo mode is labelled on the face

beats.title: THE WORLD DOOR
beats.subject: The Hand-off
beats.eye: The world checks the gate's signed assertion itself: seated, ended, or honestly unchecked.
beats.markers: no automatic bounce in any outcome; the gate is reached by a link, by a human click

beats.title: THE ORB FRAME
beats.subject: The World
beats.eye: A glass orb held by three spinning strands over a gold plane, framed 32 LOW / 32 HIGH.
beats.markers: the frame header as the founder captured it in the world build; this rendering is this package's scaffold of that frame, labelled as such

beats.title: THE DIAMOND WORLD
beats.subject: The Sectors
beats.eye: Three rings. One seed. White light refracted into the sectors the house measures.
beats.markers: sector tokens as named in the world build's own source: WATER / ENERGY / CLIMATE / FOOD / PANDEMIC / PHARMA; the founder's interior capture also shows HEALTH and EDUCATION — both facts printed, neither chosen quietly

beats.title: FUEL THE PEG
beats.subject: The Peg
beats.eye: The slot's law, without a till: Merit is never for sale; verified work feeds the peg.
beats.markers: spine slot VIII·B; no payment provider is named or wired on this face — the refusal is recorded in STRUCTURE-MAP.md

beats.title: THE MENU
beats.subject: The Memory
beats.eye: Everything the old world holds, categorized by a generated store — status and grade on every row.
beats.markers: the package's own addition to the spine, named as such in STRUCTURE-MAP.md; the store is generated by this tool; a correction is a new build, never an edit

beats.title: MANIFESTO — THE QUIET CLOSE
beats.subject: The Close
beats.eye: The closing line, and the three doors. Nothing else leaves the page.
beats.markers: spine slot IX; closing line verbatim, exactly once
